sentences.text:
( i) In the event of arrest of the applicant in C.R.No. 802 of 2021 registered with MIDC Police Station, Solapur City for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26 (2) (I), 26 (2) (iv), 27 (2) (e), and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006, the applicant be enlarged on bail on his furnishing PR & SB in the sum of Rs. 20,000/- with one or two surety/sureties in like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer of concerned police station as and when required.
(iii) The applicant shall not tamper with prosecution evidence.
(iv) Issue notice to the concerned police station, returnable on 25th January, 2022.
(v) This order shall remain in force till the next date.
